reason: In src/sentry/api/helpers/error_upsampling.py, the cache key is built only from the org id and a hash of the sorted project ids, with no allowlist contents in it, and the result is cached for 60s (patch lines 153 and 164). invalidate_upsampling_cache (error_upsampling.py:67) is never called anywhere in the repo, so after a project is removed from the allowlist it stays upsampled until the cache entry expires.
